BiblicalUsage: ʻEther was a town in the lowland of Judah. The name occurs in Joshua. There is no People profile for it, because it is a place, not a person.
TheologicalSignificance: I take ʻEther as it stands: a place named in the record, a small mark on the map. That is enough reason to slow down and notice the name rather than skip it.
